title: Dog Ball Feeding Toys Dog Tennis Ball Feeding Machine With 2 Tennis For Dog Training
body_html: 1、SAFE PLASTIC MATERIAL: The dog tennis toy is made of plastic material, fine surface, safe and odorless. 2、2 SPILLED FOOD TRAY: The food tray is used to store the spilled snacks, and the dog can eat and play. 3、TENNIS EXIT: The tennis ball leaks from here, and puzzle to feed your dog.
